The principal unresolved risks are operational nuclear and high-risk governance evidence in 1B, civilian-harm and escalation attribution in 2B, Marcos-specific security conduct and remedies in 3B, post-inauguration political-freedom conduct in 4B, implementation and distribution in 5B-6B, personal-integrity nexus in 7B, and delivery and coordination evidence in 8B.
